note: Sheridan County, ND publishes its zoning only as PDF maps (Zoning Maps and Building Code/Zoning Maps) and a zoning plan/resolutions PDF. No ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable zoning polygon layer was found for the county or for McClusky. ArcGIS search for zoning returned only unrelated layers (roads, aquifers, base data). The Equator Studios portal lists parcels, buildings and contours, not zoning.
